fit_note: GPT-4V planner emits a textual action description, then a separate grounding step maps it to an element; grounding is via HTML candidates/SoM/attributes rather than a trained pure-vision grounder, so the K22 grounder half is prompt-based.

Prompted GPT-4V web agent whose action interface is Set-of-Mark numeric labels on rule-extracted interactive elements (element-tag ACI, K29); but the interface is borrowed rather than redesigned, and the paper's other contributions (live-web benchmark, GPT-4V auto-evaluator ~K16) are not covered by K29.

Benchmark whose core contribution is durable reward from privileged Android state (adb: databases, files, settings) with parameterized tasks; K13 rejected because checkers are hand-written per task, not task-synthesis-from-checkers.

Core contribution is a multi-platform toolkit reading element boxes from HTML/A11y trees to synthesise grounding data, plus a unified action space; also touches K22 (grounding mode with GPT-4o planner) and K29.

ShowUI is a single end-to-end 2B VLA (UI-guided visual token selection, interleaved vision-language-action streaming, curated grounding/navigation data recipe). Closest is K23: it trains a screenshot coordinate grounder on curated web/mobile/desktop element data with a unified JSON action space, but its headline novelty is efficient visual token selection, which no sub-pattern covers; K29 (action interface) is the runner-up.
